name: Symmachean Stalwarts
headerMeta: Heroic era · Melee infantry · shields · 240 leadership · Seasonal & Honor (Legacy of Fire)
pitch: A near-unbreakable frontal wall that wins blobs, skirmishes, and duels through disciplined brace timing — invincible from the front, but a charge into its back is a near-guaranteed kill. It sits high on house doctrine-investment priority lists, and its one real check is heavy block-break (Claymore/Reapers with Linebreaker, or a block-break hero build).

doctrines.name: Awareness Doctrine V
doctrines.note: −500 cav charge / −20% rear; situational vs divers + cav flank + reapers diving in

doctrines.name: Noble Blood Doctrine I
doctrines.note: only effective vs vipers / AOE comps, otherwise your blocking dmg won't apply

veterancy.label: Middle
veterancy.body: Middle for +1 target, then rest top — optimal for most engagements.

battleRole.positioning: Hold chokepoints and block ranged fire as the frontline shield-wall anchor — invincible from the front, but never advance into open space without map control; anything that gets behind it turns the fight. {2}
battleRole.formation: Use F3 formation to move, then transition to F2 and insta-brace — this stacks the Stalwart tightly for much higher damage; bracing with F2 only, the back-row Stalwart is otherwise wasted, and this tech fixes that. {1}
battleRole.tips: X-move in and brace, stay braced and X-move again or use Advance and re-brace every time brace cooldown is up. {1} CCi (Stand Fast) is your reset button — pop it vs polearm ulting you, enemy Imperial Pike, cavalry charge, or any CC; it resets both block bar and CC on you. {1} Never V (retreat) with Stalwart, only brace. {1}

cards.name: Cavalry (rear charge)
cards.why: invincible from the front — a front charge is close to suicide — but a charge into the back is a near-guaranteed kill

cards.name: Poleaxe/billhook block-break hero build
cards.why: flameshackle-armor poleaxe pushback and billhook block-break anything they touch; house thread credits repeated block-breaks on Stalwarts for turning a 70-kill fight into 200

cards.name: All ranged and melee units
cards.why: counters everything with a good CCi doctrine timing

matchups.pressure: House doctrine-investment priority (StaRBuRsT): ranked directly below Iron Reapers/Queen Knights/Liao for general spend, and inside the top four for the purple meta. {3}

controls.notes: Core loop: X-move in or advance, brace (1), repeat. {1} CCi (Stand Fast) resets both your block bar and any CC on you — pop it vs polearm ultimate, enemy Imperial Pike, or cavalry charge. {1} Master the brace-timing rhythm: brace is your everything — never use V (retreat only, no brace-cancel value), stay braced, and re-brace every time the cooldown is up. {1} CCi is mandatory in every build (resets block AND breaks CC). {1} A LOT of viable doctrine combos exist; personal pick is 1x Unit Damage V + full block stack. {1}

gaps: No StarBurst house card exists for this unit — confirmed independently by both the amya-guide's own note and the OneMoreTime card-library table (18 cards listed, none for Stalwarts); Sunward Phalanx by contrast has a known 'Titanic' card.

Patch (2026-06-25): Brace damage hitbox −12%, stab damage hitbox −18% — hitbox-only tuning; shortlist assessment says no skill/mechanic change, doctrine likely still holds just slightly weaker. Pre-patch fight ratings not re-verified post-nerf.
Rear-charge/front-invincibility framing is corroborated across three unrelated video sources (2021 and 2026) but none give exact numbers — qualitative only.

Two 2021 KnightStalker transcripts (Spear Sergeants, Men-at-Arms) mention Stalwarts only as a power-comparison benchmark, not as guide subjects — no additional Stalwarts-specific mechanics beyond what's already sourced from Amya.
